style: Moody pixel art, industrial military design. Dark violet to crimson sky, ember orange glow, hot magenta beam light.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). All five images are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record and not meant to be regenerated. The preset is the closest match to how they look, not the one they were made with.

images.prompt: Wide shot of a sleek angular space warship hovering in a dark sky above a sprawling fortified complex of concrete bunkers and turrets on rocky, burning terrain, glowing engine arrays.

Side view of a brilliant energy beam drilling down through a fortress cut away to show its layers of soil, concrete and metal, glowing molten debris cascading into the hole, hidden chambers and air pockets opening.
Inside a carved-out underground chamber, a stream of sand and debris pours through a hole in the ceiling and piles on the floor, glowing embers among the rubble, ruined concrete walls behind.
Low-angle hero shot of an imposing angular space warship against a turbulent sky, weapon arrays and engine glow, surface bunkers on the burning ground far below.
Wide view of several colony worlds across a starfield, patrol ships flying between planets along glowing routes, stations and orbital platforms dotting the void.
